description: UI/Route catalog schema shared between QD1, QD5, QD7 dimensions. Emitted by QD1 deep-ui-traversal, consumed by QD5 ui-traversal-deep and QD7 device-breakpoint-test to avoid duplicate page crawling.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when catalog was generated.

dim_source.description: Dimension probe that emitted this catalog (e.g., 'P-QD1-deep-ui-traversal').

base_url.description: Base URL used during crawl (if applicable).

url.description: Full URL or relative path of the page.

title.description: Page title (from <title> tag or route definition).

components.description: Top-level UI component names detected on this page.

routes.description: Child routes or sub-paths discovered from this page.

interactive_elements.description: Count of interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, selects).

has_form.description: Whether page contains a form element.

viewport_tested.description: Whether responsive viewport testing has been performed.
